text:
maria: Quick sync — preparing the evidence lifecycle for the SOC2 P1 cutover (target 2025-06-12). Need clear owners for: KMS rotation proof, HSM attestation certs, audit-log retention config, and evidence archive placement. Who can pick what?

sam: I can take KMS rotation proof. Will link rotation policy + sample rotation event by EOD.

jin: I'll own audit-log retention and ingest mapping. Quick q: retention window required = 365 or 540 days?

maria: Auditors said 365 is minimum for SOC2. ISO asks for 540 in some cases — let's document both and note the gap.

deploy-bot: stage-cutover: scheduled 2025-06-11T22:00Z (rolling, 2h window).

priya: HSM attestation — can the vendor provide a signed attestation PDF and chain? @alex - you on vendor side?

alex: Vendor can issue attestation on 2025-06-02. We'll get the signed pdf + chain. Need someone to archive it and drop a pointer in evidence repo.

sam: Example command to pull CloudTrail rotation events for our key alias (will attach sanitized sample): `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/redwood-kms`

jin: For audit-log ingest I'll drop a sample mapping + schema tomorrow. Also need token-redaction rules to confirm no PII lands in logs.

maria: Tentative owner assignments: KMS rotation -> sam; Auditlog retention & ingest -> jin; HSM attestation -> alex; Evidence archive & naming -> priya. If no objections I'll update the dep map.

priya: Ack — I'll create the evidence repo folder and add a README with expected artifact names.

alex: One blocker: staging isn't forwarding audit logs from 2/3 regions. @kelly can eng-infra check?

kelly: On it — deploying patch to forwarding agent now. ETA ~45m.

maria: Please standardize artifact names in PRs, e.g.: `evidence/kms/rotation-YYYYMMDD.json`, `evidence/hsm/attestation-vendor-cert.pdf`, `evidence/auditlogs/ingest-mapping-v1.yaml`

sam: Will attach sample rotation JSON under that path.

jin: Auditors asked whether signer fingerprint is required or just cert chain — what's our preference?

alex: Provide chain + fingerprint (sha256) to be safe.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll open/update INF ticket for the evidence pipeline bake so we have a checklist. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5472

incident-bot: no active incidents reported.

sam: I'll post the rotation sample by 1849990360 and tag the PR.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update the dep map and send weekly check-ins until cutover. If anyone needs handoff before next check, ping here.
